traditional: the Moon square Jupiter: a hard contact. The body, home, and daily needs works against growth, fortune, and patronage - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas.
modern: Feelings meet optimism and expansion. A resilient inner buoyancy that recovers no matter what, plus real generosity. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Emotional and physical excess; overindulgence and overcommitment. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for feeling against growth, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the feeling/growth form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Warmth and generosity that draw people in; watch the tendency to overextend.
shadow: Moodiness and over-need collides with excess and overreach; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.
base: Good news can make a situation look more promising than it is, while one frustrating development can make existing progress look suddenly insufficient.

readerCopy.body: Good news can make a situation look more promising than it is, while one frustrating development can make existing progress look suddenly insufficient. When the Moon squares Jupiter, emotion magnifies the meaning of whatever just happened, making optimism and disappointment harder to hold in proportion. Neither mood has to be distrusted. Both become more useful once they are kept from rewriting the entire situation before the larger pattern has changed.
